# node-upgrade.txt
#
# Documents the `cascade node upgrade [--all]` ⚠ behavioral scenarios
# this ticket's contract names (P1-E17-W4-S36-T5). This module carries no
# testscript (rogpeppe/testscript) dependency -- adding one needs the
# license gate this repo has not cleared (see the sibling
# fleet-sessions.txtar / context-scope-show.txtar, which make the same
# call). The scenarios below are instead expressed as executable Go in
# internal/nodes/upgrade_test.go (RunUpgrade rollout semantics),
# internal/nodes/upgrade_rpc_test.go (the real rpc.Registry.Dispatch
# wiring proof), and internal/nodes/provision_test.go (the fail-closed
# signature/checksum/version-window refusals and the atomic-install
# rollback proof). This file records the intended script form for when a
# testscript dependency is cleared.

# A bare invocation with neither NODE_ID nor --all is refused before any
# elevation prompt or dial.
! exec cascade node upgrade
stderr 'pass a NODE_ID or --all'

# --artifact/--signature are required even once a target is named.
! exec cascade node upgrade some-node
stderr '--artifact and --signature are required'

# With CASCADE_NO_INPUT=1 and no enrolled elevation helper, the elevated
# verb hard-errors rather than hanging on a local-presence prompt (06
# §5.8/§5.14).
env CASCADE_NO_INPUT=1
! exec cascade node upgrade --all --artifact does-not-exist --signature does-not-exist
stderr 'ELEVATION_REQUIRED|CASCADE_NO_INPUT'

# Windows tier-2: the verb is an asserted refusal, never a silent skip
# (06 §2, Art.5.3) -- exercised natively in
# cmd/cascade/node_windows_test.go, not here (this script's Go host
# cannot cross-compile-and-run a windows binary).
